usage.title: How to Create AI Videos with imvids
usage.description: Three steps from idea to final cut:

items.title: Pick a Model
items.description: Switch between Seedance 2.5 and MiniMax H3 as needed: choose Seedance 2.5 for cinematic camera language and multi-shot storytelling, or MiniMax H3 for natural performance and scene consistency.

items.title: Write a Prompt or Upload an Image
items.description: Describe the scene, action, camera, and style in words, or upload a reference image to run image-to-video with start/end frame control.

items.title: Generate and Download
items.description: Choose aspect ratio, duration, and resolution, then generate in one click. Preview and download directly for social media, ads, or short films.

items.question: Which AI video models does imvids support?
items.answer: imvids currently features Seedance 2.5 and MiniMax H3, two leading video generation models, and keeps adding more — all switchable from one workspace.

items.question: What are Seedance 2.5's strengths?
items.answer: Seedance 2.5 excels at cinematic camera work and multi-shot storytelling with stable physical motion — ideal for short videos and ads that need shot language and complex scene transitions.

items.question: What are MiniMax H3's strengths?
items.answer: MiniMax H3 stands out in character performance and scene consistency, with natural, fluid motion — great for narrative videos and projects demanding character consistency.

items.question: Does it support image-to-video?
items.answer: Yes. Upload a still image to animate it, or set start and end frames for precise transition control — perfect for product showcases and poster animations.

items.question: Can I switch between multiple models?
items.answer: Yes. The imvids video workspace lets you switch between models freely — run the same prompt through different models, compare results, and pick the best version.

items.question: Can I use generated videos commercially?
items.answer: Generated videos are watermark-free and downloadable for social content, ad assets, and more. Please follow each model provider's terms of use and avoid infringing or prohibited content.

items.question: How do I get started?
items.answer: Sign up to receive free credits, then start generating in the video workspace with a prompt or an uploaded image. Credits are pay-as-you-go — no subscription required.
